warnings: Two-pile cap F1 of the pile system (S-01 unboxed labels). Its section is detailed like a beam — 4-DB20 top, 5-DB20 bottom, 3x2-DB12 side bars, chain stirrups DB12@0.15 — so main_bar keeps top/middle/bottom faces (§6 'any member genuinely detailed with two longitudinal faces') instead of the single-count mat form of §6b; flagged.
Cap is not square: width_mm 1600 (along the two piles, 0.30+1.00+0.30) and depth_mm 700; height_mm 700 = cap thickness only (lean 0.05 and sand 0.10 kept in their own fields).
'~1.00' (cap top to fill level) is printed with a tilde and 'Varie' — recorded as pedestal_height_m with its printed text.
